annotations.sentence: 后来我发现，歌词也可以跟着音乐，在画面里变成主角。

annotations.sentence: 安静的时候，文字慢慢浮出来；节奏一起来，整句话直接冲到你面前。

annotations.sentence: 别人用 AI，十分钟就把工作做完了。你用 AI，光改提示词就折腾了半小时。

annotations.sentence: 对话框越拉越长，答案生成了一版又一版，能直接用的却没几句。

comic_clarification.interpretation: One comic source sheet contains consecutive actions of the same character; split/crop panels or action images and sequence/overlay them across a few seconds for animation-like performance. observed_facts.claim: All 9 answered items in the emotion group select comic action sequences
Q16 selects a fixed answer with highlighted sentence changes and an increasing version history
Q47 selects a direct cut back to the error; Q50 selects complete playback followed by replay of the key change

contextual_inferences.summary: A named object should enter according to why it is mentioned: launch/identity, demonstrated capability, modifiability, added capability, or discovery through content. Avoid one universal logo reveal.
Concrete operations need visible cause and feedback. Cursor movement alone is insufficient.
Use moving mechanisms for conceptual relationships when these explain the relation; use actual UI/process when that already explains it.
Current preference for human emotional beats is consecutive comic performance, with AIGC available later.

For multi-material displays, simultaneously active real assets can establish variety, then the camera or selected item approaches before returning to the whole. Tool comparisons prioritize comparable results.
Maintain spatial context when locating controls or explaining details; continuous transitions are not mandatory when direct cuts or replay aid understanding.
Results can be the entry for explaining capability/comparison/provenance and the exit after a completed workflow.

updates_and_limits.earlier: ai-prompt-round item 2 proposed repeated answer appearances with effects and sounds
updates_and_limits.later: Questionnaire Q16 selects fixed-answer change tracking
updates_and_limits.application: For the corresponding repeated-revision context prefer the later Q16 choice; do not erase the earlier idea or ban all multiple-answer montages/sound effects.

updates_and_limits.later: Q47 direct correction cut and Q50 replay selected
updates_and_limits.application: Continuity serves comprehension; do not impose one-take motion on every sentence.

updates_and_limits.choice: Q45 retains narration and software sound with modest camera movement
updates_and_limits.application: Do not default to an added click sound for every action; this does not establish a general dislike of sound design.
